# SHADER7 (https://shader7.com)

> SHADER7 is a high-performance suite of free, privacy-first, client-side web applications and CNC machinist engineering tools. All computation executes locally inside the user's browser sandbox with zero external server uploads.

## Key Applications & Tools in the SHADER7 Suite

1. **Passport Photo Studio Pro** (https://shader7.com/photopassportsizepro/)
   - AI background replacement, official biometric specifications for 150+ countries (US 2x2", UK 35x45mm, Schengen, India), and automated 4x6 printable grid generator.

2. **CNC Machinist Toolkit** (https://shader7.com/cnc-machinist/)
   - Shop floor engineering suite: Milling Speeds & Feeds, Drill & Tap Charts, PCD Bolt Circles, Circular Arc Interpolation (G02/G03), Chamfer & Corner Radius calculations, and Fanuc Custom Macro B routines.

3. **3D CAD Studio Web Modeler** (https://shader7.com/cnc-machinist/3DCADWEB/)
   - In-browser 3D geometry modeler, stock bounding box simulation, and STL/STEP inspection.

4. **Universal Triangle Solver** (https://shader7.com/cnc-machinist/Triangle/)
   - Trigonometric geometry calculator solving right and oblique triangles with SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, and SSA laws of sines and cosines.

5. **Photo Compressor Pro** (https://shader7.com/photocompressor/)
   - Lossless and lossy client-side compression for JPG, PNG, and WebP images with custom target size (KB) controls.

6. **CV Banao ATS Resume Builder** (https://shader7.com/cvbanao/)
   - Privacy-focused resume builder with 5 ATS-compliant templates and vector PDF rendering.

7. **Receipt Pro Invoice Generator** (https://shader7.com/receiptpro/)
   - Itemized sales receipt and tax invoice generator with instant printable PDF export.

8. **Hourly to Salary Calculator** (https://shader7.com/hourlysalarycalculator/)
   - Wage conversion calculator analyzing gross pay, taxes, deductions, and 50/30/20 budget allocations.

9. **FairShare Bill & Expense Splitter** (https://shader7.com/fairshare/)
   - Group expense tracking and debt minimization matrix for roommates and travel trips.

10. **Ber of Chat P2P Private Messaging** (https://shader7.com/berofchat/)
    - Serverless peer-to-peer encrypted text and file sharing over WebRTC data channels.

## Core Architectural Philosophy
- **100% Client-Side:** Sensitive files, images, and calculations are processed directly on the client machine using WebAssembly, HTML5 Canvas, Web Workers, and WebRTC.
- **Zero Mandatory Signups:** Open access without paywalls, subscriptions, or forced account creation.
- **Progressive Web App (PWA):** Full offline caching with installability across iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows.
